draft.subject: A first project in Wrenfield, whenever you're ready
draft.body:
Hi Ahmed,

I know a new tool is easy to put off, so I won't pile on. One small thing tends to unlock the rest: in Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so a single real project is usually enough to see how it fits your work. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project.

If it's easier, I'm happy to set up a short call this week and get that first project started with you.

Best,
Priya
